description: The entity does not create and retain a record of authorized disclosures of personal information. This signal indicates that the organization lacks documentation of legitimate data sharing activities, making it difficult to demonstrate compliance with privacy commitments and track data flows.
applicability: Applicable to data sharing operations, third-party integrations, consent management systems, data processing agreements, and disclosure tracking mechanisms.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through review of disclosure logs, consent records, data sharing agreements, audit trails, and privacy documentation. May be identified by absence of disclosure tracking, missing authorization documentation, or incomplete record-keeping practices.
